story.title: RUN !!! A GHOST COMES
paragraphs_en: Once there was a beautiful village named KUNDALPUR

One night an old man was walking on the streets of Kundalpur village.It was late and the streets were lonely.The man was happy as he had earned a lot of money that day but suddenly he heard a hissing sound . He was afraid. Who-who is there?
S uddenly a ghost appeared from nowhere. HA !HA!HA! I am a ghost if you want to be alive do as I say. Handover all your money ,jewels and belongings and run away
The man handed whatever he had and ran away. The news of a ghost in the village spread fast.
Chinti ,her brother Montu and her friends were well known for their bravery.
Chinti and Montu along with their friends decide that they will search for the ghost at night.
At night all the children secretly came out of their house and gathered in a park where the ghost was seen last time. Next they decided who will search which place.
Montu and ritesh search behind the broken wall .
Suddenly a flock of bats came towards Ritesh. He screamed and ran away and told everything to Montu.

No one was able to find the ghost.Soon they all gathered. Every one was sad except Chinti. She gave them a motivating speech and reminded them of the secret cave which they had discovered a month ago and none of them had searched that part. Chinti carrying a thick stick led them to that place and hid behind the trees.

Soon enough they saw someone in ghost costume and in a flash Chinti rushed to the ghost and started beating him with the stick.Listening to the cry of the man which was dressed as a ghost his partners came to protect him but were badly beaten by the kids . Ahhh!!!!

Montu rushed to the village and called the policeman. The police came back with Montu and arrested the thieves.The police admired the group and told them that they had been searching for this gang since months but couldn't find them.They were also invited for prize distribution ceremony for the bravest kids.
Thus all ended well in the village of Kundalpur. The kids were awarded ,praised and most importantly offered lots of sweets and candies...

sentences.text_en: Once there was a beautiful village named KUNDALPUR
sentences.text_vi: Ngày xửa ngày xưa, có một ngôi làng xinh đẹp tên là KUNDALPUR.

sentences.text_en: One night an old man was walking on the streets of Kundalpur village.It was late and the streets were lonely.The man was happy as he had earned a lot of money that day but suddenly he heard a hissing sound .

sentences.text_en: HA !HA!HA! I am a ghost if you want to be alive do as I say.
sentences.text_vi: HA! HA! HA! Ta là ma đây! Nếu ngươi muốn sống, hãy làm theo lời ta nói.

sentences.text_en: Chinti and Montu along with their friends decide that they will search for the ghost at night.
sentences.text_vi: Chinti và Montu cùng với các bạn quyết định sẽ đi tìm con ma vào ban đêm.

sentences.text_en: At night all the children secretly came out of their house and gathered in a park where the ghost was seen last time.
sentences.text_vi: Ban đêm, tất cả bọn trẻ bí mật ra khỏi nhà và tập trung ở một công viên, nơi con ma được nhìn thấy lần cuối.

sentences.text_en: Next they decided who will search which place.
sentences.text_vi: Tiếp theo, chúng quyết định ai sẽ tìm ở đâu.

sentences.text_en: Montu and ritesh search behind the broken wall .
sentences.text_vi: Montu và Ritesh tìm kiếm phía sau bức tường đổ nát.

sentences.text_en: Suddenly a flock of bats came towards Ritesh.
sentences.text_vi: Đột nhiên, một đàn dơi bay về phía Ritesh.

sentences.text_en: He screamed and ran away and told everything to Montu.
sentences.text_vi: Cậu bé hét lên rồi chạy đi và kể lại mọi chuyện cho Montu.

sentences.text_en: No one was able to find the ghost.Soon they all gathered.
sentences.text_vi: Không ai tìm thấy con ma. Chẳng mấy chốc, tất cả lại tập trung lại.

sentences.text_en: Every one was sad except Chinti.
sentences.text_vi: Ai cũng buồn, trừ Chinti.

sentences.text_en: She gave them a motivating speech and reminded them of the secret cave which they had discovered a month ago and none of them had searched that part.
sentences.text_vi: Cô bé đã có một bài phát biểu động viên và nhắc nhở họ về hang động bí mật mà họ đã khám phá ra một tháng trước, và chưa ai tìm kiếm ở đó cả.

sentences.text_en: Chinti carrying a thick stick led them to that place and hid behind the trees.
sentences.text_vi: Chinti cầm một cây gậy to dẫn họ đến chỗ đó và nấp sau những cái cây.

sentences.text_en: Soon enough they saw someone in ghost costume and in a flash Chinti rushed to the ghost and started beating him with the stick.Listening to the cry of the man which was dressed as a ghost his partners came to protect him but were badly beaten by the kids . Ahhh!!!!
sentences.text_vi: Chẳng mấy chốc, họ thấy một người mặc đồ ma, và trong chớp mắt, Chinti lao đến con ma và bắt đầu đánh hắn bằng cây gậy. Nghe tiếng kêu của người đàn ông mặc đồ ma, đồng bọn của hắn chạy đến bảo vệ nhưng cũng bị bọn trẻ đánh cho tơi bời. Áhh!!!!

sentences.text_en: Montu rushed to the village and called the policeman.
sentences.text_vi: Montu vội chạy về làng và gọi cảnh sát.

sentences.text_en: The police came back with Montu and arrested the thieves.The police admired the group and told them that they had been searching for this gang since months but couldn't find them.They were also invited for prize distribution ceremony for the bravest kids.
sentences.text_vi: Cảnh sát quay lại cùng Montu và bắt giữ những tên trộm. Cảnh sát khen ngợi nhóm trẻ và nói rằng họ đã tìm kiếm băng nhóm này suốt nhiều tháng nhưng không thể tìm thấy. Bọn trẻ cũng được mời đến buổi lễ trao giải cho những đứa trẻ dũng cảm nhất.

sentences.text_en: Thus all ended well in the village of Kundalpur.
sentences.text_vi: Vậy là mọi chuyện đều kết thúc tốt đẹp ở làng Kundalpur.

sentences.text_en: The kids were awarded ,praised and most importantly offered lots of sweets and candies...
sentences.text_vi: Bọn trẻ được trao giải, được khen ngợi và quan trọng nhất là được tặng rất nhiều bánh kẹo...
